boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten student-accessible campus and university-supported activities documented as free for UM-Dearborn students.

cards.title: Walk the Environmental Study Area trails
cards.subtitle: Environmental Interpretive Center, UM-Dearborn campus
cards.notes: Meet up for a self-paced walk through the 120-acre nature preserve; bring water, stay on marked routes, and notice the changing habitats.
cards.short_summary: A campus nature walk with room for conversation and observation.
cards.evidence_claim: UM-Dearborn identifies the Environmental Interpretive Center as a campus resource with winding trails in its 120-acre nature preserve.
cards.source_title: Everyone likes free stuff—Here’s what UM-Dearborn offers its students
cards.access_notes: The university lists this as a free experience for UM-Dearborn students.

cards.title: Work out at the Wellness Center
cards.subtitle: Fieldhouse, UM-Dearborn campus
cards.notes: Bring your student ID and choose a low-key workout together using cardio or strength equipment; coordinate a time that fits the center’s posted schedule.
cards.short_summary: Student-accessible fitness space in the Fieldhouse.
cards.evidence_claim: UM-Dearborn states that students have free access to the Wellness Center and describes its cardio and strength equipment.
cards.access_notes: Open to current students, faculty, and staff; check the university for current facility hours.

cards.title: Go to open skate at the Fieldhouse
cards.subtitle: Fieldhouse, UM-Dearborn campus
cards.notes: Plan a casual skate session with classmates and ask about the open-skate schedule before going; student skate rentals are listed at no charge.
cards.short_summary: A campus ice-rink activity with free student access.
cards.evidence_claim: UM-Dearborn says the Fieldhouse offers open skate free to students and that skates can be rented at no charge.
cards.source_title: Everyone likes free stuff—Here’s what UM-Dearborn offers its students
cards.access_notes: Available to UM-Dearborn students; confirm open-skate availability with the Fieldhouse.

cards.entity_name: The Henry Ford Museum of American Innovation and Greenfield Village
cards.title: Explore The Henry Ford with student membership
cards.subtitle: The Henry Ford, Dearborn
cards.notes: Use the university-listed annual student membership to plan an exhibit or village visit together; check the venue calendar for what is operating that day.
cards.short_summary: Museum and historic-village exploration supported by a student membership.
cards.evidence_claim: UM-Dearborn states that students can receive a free annual membership to Henry Ford Museum and Greenfield Village.
cards.source_title: Everyone likes free stuff—Here’s what UM-Dearborn offers its students
cards.access_notes: For UM-Dearborn students using the university-listed free annual membership; verify visit details with the venue.

cards.title: Visit the Arab American National Museum
cards.subtitle: Arab American National Museum, Dearborn
cards.notes: Arrange a museum visit with friends using the university-listed student membership, then spend time discussing one gallery or object that stood out.
cards.short_summary: A local cultural-museum visit available through a student benefit.
cards.evidence_claim: UM-Dearborn states that students can receive a free annual membership to the Arab American Museum.
cards.source_title: Everyone likes free stuff—Here’s what UM-Dearborn offers its students
cards.access_notes: For UM-Dearborn students using the university-listed free annual membership; check the museum before visiting.

cards.title: Wander Matthaei Botanical Gardens
cards.subtitle: Matthaei Botanical Gardens, Ann Arbor
cards.notes: Pick a garden area to explore at an unhurried pace and bring a notebook or camera for details you notice; check conditions before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A plant-focused outing available as a free student experience.
cards.evidence_claim: UM-Dearborn states that its students can access Matthaei Botanical Gardens for free.
cards.source_title: Everyone likes free stuff—Here’s what UM-Dearborn offers its students
cards.access_notes: UM-Dearborn lists free student access; confirm garden access and travel details before departure.

cards.entity_name: University of Michigan School of Music, Theatre & Dance performances
cards.title: See a School of Music, Theatre & Dance performance
cards.subtitle: University of Michigan, Ann Arbor
cards.notes: Choose a listed play, musical, opera, or dance performance and make it a shared evening; reserve or confirm student entry through the presenting school.
cards.short_summary: Live campus arts performances included as a student benefit.
cards.evidence_claim: UM-Dearborn states that its students can attend University of Michigan School of Music, Theatre & Dance performances for free.
cards.source_title: Everyone likes free stuff—Here’s what UM-Dearborn offers its students
cards.access_notes: UM-Dearborn lists performances as free for its students; confirm the specific event’s student-entry process.

cards.entity_name: University of Michigan Museum of Art
cards.title: Look through UMMA’s galleries
cards.subtitle: University of Michigan Museum of Art, Ann Arbor
cards.notes: Meet at the museum, pick a gallery to browse slowly, and compare favorite works afterward; verify gallery availability before traveling from Dearborn.
cards.short_summary: An art-museum outing with free UM-Dearborn student admission.
cards.evidence_claim: UM-Dearborn states that its students receive free admission to the University of Michigan Museum of Art.
cards.source_title: Everyone likes free stuff—Here’s what UM-Dearborn offers its students
cards.access_notes: For UM-Dearborn students; verify current museum entry information before visiting.

cards.title: Cheer at a Wolverine home game
cards.subtitle: UM-Dearborn athletics venues
cards.notes: Check the home schedule, invite friends, and arrive ready to support the team; choose a sport and venue that work for your group’s timetable.
cards.short_summary: Free student admission to a campus sports event.
cards.evidence_claim: UM-Dearborn states that students can watch Wolverine sports including football, hockey, basketball, and soccer with free admission.
cards.source_title: Everyone likes free stuff—Here’s what UM-Dearborn offers its students
cards.access_notes: UM-Dearborn lists free student admission; check the athletics schedule for a current home event.

cards.title: Attend a Fairlane Music Guild concert
cards.subtitle: Fair Lane, Dearborn
cards.notes: Choose a listed concert and bring your valid student ID for entry; review the program beforehand so your group can decide what performance to attend.
cards.short_summary: A student-ID concert outing at historic Fair Lane.
cards.evidence_claim: UM-Dearborn states that Fairlane Music Guild grants students free entry to concerts upon showing valid student ID.
cards.source_title: Everyone likes free stuff—Here’s what UM-Dearborn offers its students
cards.access_notes: Valid UM-Dearborn student ID required; confirm the concert schedule and entry details with Fairlane Music Guild.
